Title: Python Tuples
Description: Tuples are used to store multiple items in a single variable. They are ordered and unchangeable.

Challenges.Title: Create a tuple
Challenges.Exercise: Create a tuple named `fruit` containing 'apple' and 'banana' and print it.

Challenges.Title: Access tuple items
Challenges.Exercise: Print the second item in the `fruit` tuple.

Challenges.Title: Update tuples
Challenges.Exercise: Convert `fruit` to a list `y`, change the first item to 'kiwi', and convert back to tuple `fruit`.
Challenges.Solution:
fruit = ('apple', 'banana')
y = list(fruit)
y[0] = 'kiwi'
fruit = tuple(y)
print(fruit)

Challenges.Title: Unpack tuples
Challenges.Exercise: Unpack the `fruit` tuple into variables `green` and `yellow` and print `green`.

Challenges.Title: Join tuples
Challenges.Exercise: Join tuple `tuple1 = (1, 2)` and `tuple2 = (3, 4)` into `tuple3` and print it.
Challenges.Solution:
tuple1 = (1, 2)
tuple2 = (3, 4)
tuple3 = tuple1 + tuple2
print(tuple3)
